lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Plate (skin 2) to tab (skin 4) fold of about 90 deg. In perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% the label point sits on the convex outer arc apex: the outermost surface point along -bisector within 1 mm laterally is +0.05, -0.02 and -0.02 mm from the line. The line runs parallel to the fold and spans the full tab width (16.7 mm line against a tab about 16.2-16.4 mm wide; in the side close-up both ends sit on the tab side edges). The slotted hole beside the bend cuts the tab leg in the sections but does not interrupt the arc.
